title.zh: 月相 · 从地球看被照亮的那一半
title.en: Moon Phases · The Lit Half, Seen from Earth

description.zh: 月亮永远亮半边；从地球看到的亮面比例是 (1 − cos θ)/2，周期约 29.5 天。假设圆轨道与平行光，北半球视角。
description.en: The Moon is always half lit; the fraction seen from Earth is (1 − cos θ)/2 with a period of about 29.5 days. Assumes a circular orbit, parallel light and a northern-hemisphere view.

label.en: Position angle sets the lit fraction

reason.zh: 月亮在轨道上的角度 θ 通过 cos θ 决定亮面的比例，这是单位圆上余弦的直接应用。
reason.en: The Moon's orbital angle θ sets the lit fraction through cos θ, a direct use of the cosine on the unit circle.

title.en: Why does the Moon change shape?

ask.zh: 月亮永远亮半边，为什么我们有时只看到一小部分亮面？
ask.en: The Moon is always half lit — so why do we sometimes see only a sliver of bright face?

ask.zh: 把月亮绕地球的位置想成圆上的一个角，看到的亮面比例 (1 − cos θ)/2 在 θ 很小和 θ = 180° 时各是多少？
ask.en: Think of the Moon's position as an angle on a circle — what is the lit fraction (1 − cos θ)/2 when θ is tiny, and when θ = 180°?

reveal.zh: 亮面比例由月亮相对太阳的位置角决定，θ 从 0 变到 180°，亮面从 0 变到全部，大约 29.5 天一个周期。
reveal.en: The lit fraction follows the Moon's angle relative to the Sun: as θ goes from 0 to 180°, the lit face grows from none to full, over a cycle of about 29.5 days.
